name: Analog Digital Clock
description: Highly configurable SVG and CSS-based clock blocks. Includes multiple layouts for real-time Analog and Digital displays with custom timezones, colors, and font settings.
project_description: The Analog Digital Clock (ADC Block) module provides real-time analog and digital clock blocks for Drupal, placed and configured through the core Block system. It ships four Block plugins: a Canvas-based analog clock (adc_block_block), a CSS/HTML digital clock (adc_block_digital_block), and two SVG-rendered variants (svg_clock_analog_dynamic and svg_clock_digital_dynamic). Each block exposes extensive per-instance styling: colors for the face, hands, ticks, numbers and text; hand/tick widths and lengths; borders, shadows and glow effects; font family, size and weight; and (for the digital blocks) date and day display with selectable or custom PHP date formats. Time is resolved and updated entirely client-side by attached JavaScript, so the blocks declare getCacheMaxAge() 0 (uncacheable). Timezone can follow the site/system timezone, the visitor's local browser timezone, or a specific named timezone. The two legacy blocks offer numbered preset layouts (layout1..layout10 for analog) plus a Custom mode; the two SVG blocks are fully custom with grouped detail forms. Templates (analog-clock.html.twig, digital-clock.html.twig, svg-clock-analog-dynamic.html.twig, svg-clock-digital-dynamic.html.twig) are overridable in a theme. The module has no routes, permissions, services, or external dependencies; all clock logic uses native browser APIs. It requires Drupal core 9, 10 or 11 and the core Block module. Maintained by Sujan Shrestha; project security_advisory_coverage is not-covered.
